title: 仲量联行CEO：节能是常识，能源涨价倒逼企业双赢？
speaker: Christian Ulbrich

segments.en: I also want to ask you about your climate initiative. I heard this is something you are passionate about and want to talk about.
segments.zh: 我还想问问您的气候倡议，听说您对此充满热情，愿意谈谈。

segments.en: People always think that this is something really special. I would say it's just common sense.
segments.zh: 人们总觉得这很特别，但我觉得这只是常识。

segments.en: We need to save energy because it makes sense from a business perspective and the proof of the last couple of weeks is again there that when energy prices are going up that's a cost factor for many organizations.
segments.zh: 我们需要节能，因为从商业角度看这是合理的。最近几周再次证明，能源价格上涨对许多组织来说都是成本因素。

segments.en: So we try so hard to reduce cost and be super efficient everywhere. It makes a lot of sense to be it also on the energy site and then you have a double win.
segments.zh: 我们努力降低成本，提高效率。在能源方面也同样如此，这样就能实现双赢。

segments.en: You are saving money and you are less polluting the world and then we can debate what impact that pollution has but clearly it has an impact and if we can reduce that impact I think that makes a lot of sense.
segments.zh: 你既节省了资金，又减少了对世界的污染。我们可以讨论污染的影响，但显然它是有影响的，如果能减少这种影响，我认为非常有意义。
